question: How does abstaining from food by day affect death related to aging?
premises: A regimen involving non-eating by day is prescribed
Aging and death are the conditions addressed
inference: By abstaining from food during the day, one will overcome death associated with aging.
uncertainties: gamiṣyate interpreted as going beyond or overcoming in this context
plain_english: By abstaining from food during the day, one will overcome death due to aging.
